titel: Here, on Ward Twelve, we meet Ingrid. Seventy-eight years old, and recovering from surgery. And, like most of us, she finds that a good meal can brighten the whole day.
inloggning: She raises her wrist to the tablet. The hospital wristband she was given on arrival is all she needs. No passwords. No fuss.
bestallningar: At once, her day comes into view. Lunch and dinner are still waiting for her decision, and the clock is ticking: forty-four minutes left to order lunch. At the very top, always in sight, her diet. Only the staff can change it.
meny: Before her, the menu unfolds. Only dishes that suit her diet are allowed here. Nothing she cannot eat.
ratten: She settles on the salmon. With it, a cup of coffee. The list of ingredients shows every allergen in bold, so nothing comes as a surprise.
kolla: One last look. Is everything right?
klart: It is. The order slides into place among the others, and at noon, lunch will arrive at her bedside.
sprak: And should the next patient prefer Arabic, it takes just two taps.
slut: My Meal. Food she wants to eat, chosen by herself.
